text:
sophie chen: quick sync — NebulaWeights (vendor) wants their 13B checkpoint listed in marketplaces + sold as an SI HW/runtime bundle. we need to confirm redistribution carveouts and reseller rights. @ana legal @oliver grant

raj patel: do we have their license? any "no redistribution" language?

maya lopez: they sent a short addendum: commercial use ok, must keep attribution, and "no relicensing" of raw weights. uploaded to partnership drive.

ana legal: skimmed it. that "no relicensing" phrase is broad. recommends: carve out hosted endpoints and authorized reseller packaged distributions (no raw weight dumps). relax UI attribution to footer/link.

oliver grant: marketplace standpoint: acceptable if we add a redistribution appendix explaining artifacts we host (endpoint, quantized container) and that raw checkpoints won't be published. each cloud (aws/gcp/azure) wants a slightly different metadata flag.

raj patel: SI partner expects to ship prebuilt container images to customers under reseller terms. vendor's clause blocks that; we need a reseller exception permitting packaged, non-extractable distributions by authorized channels.

ana legal: proposed summary for reseller carveout: allow Redwood and authorized resellers to distribute packaged runtime images which prevent extraction of raw weights, preserve vendor attribution, and include a security-update obligation. include fallback: hosted-only listing if vendor won't accept.

maya lopez: i'll draft a plain-language note to vendor explaining the carveout and what "non-extractable" means at a high level.

oliver grant: ops note: require attestation + packaging checklist rather than heavyweight crypto by default. checklist items: no raw .bin in container, runtime key gating or obfuscation, test harness for extraction checks, attribution metadata file, update cadence.

sophie chen: timeline: can legal produce the one-paragraph addendum + 5-point internal checklist by EOD tomorrow? we may need to delay the joint announcement otherwise.

analegal: yes — will draft and upload.

marketplace-bot: doc uploaded: https://redwood-internal/share/nebula-13b-addendum-draft.pdf (access: partnerships+marketplace).

raj patel: i'll sync with SI to confirm they can meet packaging requirements and test harness by next week.

maya lopez: after legal review i'll send vendor comms and offer a short walkthrough.

oliver grant: i'll map checklist to marketplace flags once doc is in. note: aws needs explicit redistribution flag, gcp wants single-line license, azure wants UI attribution guidance.

sophie chen: recap actions: 1) @ana legal draft addendum + checklist (EOD tomorrow) 2) @raj confirm SI packaging acceptance 3) @oliver map marketplace flags 4) @maya send vendor comms. thanks team :rocket:
